rule: A plain JSON note store (json.loads only) read naively: a stored status field is taken as the status; otherwise a requirement is 'verified' when its recorded native query executed and its recorded numbers match a recorded expected value.

cases.false_state: metric executed => requirement verified (both French-market readings execute and match their oracles)
approval flag set without an approval object => equivalence approved
receipt from a different semantic revision => verified
status proxy executes and matches its own oracle => settlement verified
approval of another clause version => approved
derived expression executes => unit-price threshold verified despite quantity <= 0 rows
status: VERIFIED written into the record => verified
